messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service `prod-inference-storage` (P1) — Trigger: high error rate 502s. Targeting escalation policy `infra-storage-escalation`. URL: https://pagerduty.com/INC12345
Priya (Eng-SRE): I just got paged — storage team? I'm on infra-sre rotation, not storage. :thinking_face:
Alex Li: I saw the same. This is weird, prod-inference-storage should only page DB-team. Are we seeing duplicate bindings?
Jonas (Platform): Paging PD console now. Looks like a recent config change bound `prod-inference-alerts` to `infra-storage-escalation` by mistake in PD service mapping. I can revert.
Maya (Support): Customers reporting inference failures in EU-1 via Intercom, about a handful but growing. Triage shows 504s from runtime. No incidents in DB logs yet.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Quick ask — can someone ack the page so we stop spamming folks? I'll start looking at route mapping and runtime metrics.
PagerDuty Bot: ACK: Alert INC12345 acknowledged by Alex Li at 2026-03-14 14:12:10 UTC.
Alex Li: Acked. I'm live on the incident. Priya — what do traces show? Any obvious culprit in the serving fleet?
Priya (Eng-SRE): Traces show elevated tail latency on model host pool in eu-west-1 around 14:09. But the alerting rule threshold is 5xx rate > 3% — our runtime telemetry shows 5% for ~4 minutes. Suspect a bad rollout or upstream cache miss. I'm pulling rollout/kanary info.
Jonas (Platform): Reverted the PD service binding: removed `prod-inference-alerts` -> `infra-storage-escalation` mapping and re-bound to `prod-llm-runtime-escalation`. Command I ran: ```pd service edit PROD-INFERENCE-ALERT --escalation prod-llm-runtime-escalation``` Confirmed change in PD UI.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Good. That explains why storage was getting pages. Can we suppress further pages to infra-storage while we investigate?
PagerDuty Bot: UPDATE: Routing changed for INC12345. Escalation now set to `prod-llm-runtime-escalation`.
Maya (Support): Noted — I'll update affected customer threads: telling them we're investigating and may have transient errors, ETA unknown.
Alex Li: Rolling back the last runtime rollout in eu-west-1 now — issuing `rollback release v2026-03-14-2` (started).
Priya (Eng-SRE): Logs (excerpt): ```2026-03-14T14:08:54Z inference-runner[host-42]: ERROR upstream 502 model-timeout; cache-miss: true
2026-03-14T14:09:12Z inference-runner[host-17]: WARN kv-cache miss rate spike 0.47``` Looks like a cache invalidation combined with a slow kernel path.
Jonas (Platform): Suggestion: add a PD rule to validate service bindings against a team ownership map; that would've flagged this mapping. Opening a ticket.
Alex Li: Rollback completed at 14:16. Error rate dropping now — telemetry shows 1.2% 5xx in eu-west-1 and counting down.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Confirming recovery trend. No further pages after rebind. Impact window ~14:08–14:16. Estimate: ~8 minutes of elevated errors, affecting ~4% of EU traffic peak.
Maya (Support): I've posted a short status update to impacted customers and Slack support channel. Will follow up if they escalate.
Jonas (Platform): Created follow-up ticket PD-ROLL-457: audit PD service bindings + add CI gate. Assigning to `platform` and `eng-sre`.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Action items: 1) add CI check for PD bindings (Jonas) 2) run a replay test for the rollback path (Priya) 3) postmortem if customer impact confirmed (Maya to lead comms).
Alex Li: Oncall handoff in ~20 minutes — I'll leave notes in the incident thread and tag the next oncall. @Jonas, @Priya please add anything else. :white_check_mark:
Jonas (Platform): Adding logs and PD audit snapshot to the ticket. Also scheduled a PD permissions review to reduce accidental remaps.
Incident Bot: Incident INC12345 resolved (auto) — Status: recovered. Closed at 2026-03-14 14:25:30 UTC.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Will draft a short blameless postmortem and include timeline + customer impact. Thanks everyone for quick coordination. :heart:
Maya (Support): Thanks — I'll keep monitoring customer threads.
Alex Li: Good job. Reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:
